item.title: AA Edit | Keep Striving For Equal Society
item.description: The Supreme Court’s refusal to entertain a petition seeking formulation of guidelines to recognise racial slur as a separate category of hate crime on the plea that classifying crimes based on the victim’s identity could risk dividing society is in complete dissonance with the realities of Indian life.
